Reference / fs/lock

fs/lock#

Whole-file advisory locks.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let file = File(path: path, mode: FileMode.reading_and_writing);
defer file.close();
let lock = file.lock(FileLockMode.exclusive) else throw Busy.now;
defer lock.close();
file.locked(FileLockMode.shared);    // whether anyone holds it shared now

Description#

Whole-file advisory locks. A file takes them, and a lock that is in the way is an ordinary branch, not an error:

Locks are advisory and whole-file on every provider: they keep out those who lock too, not every writer. Shared locks coexist only with shared locks; an exclusive lock conflicts with every other lock. A file holds at most one live lock. Closing the lock or its file releases it, both closes are idempotent, and the lock keeps its file open while it lives.
